query:
SELECT
                 COUNT(i.id) AS "total!: i64",
                 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM files f
                   WHERE f.issue_id = i.id
                     AND f.status = 'owned'
                     AND f.is_present = 1
                 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "owned!: i64"
               FROM issues i WHERE i.series_id = ?
